description: Land Acquisition - Wilpita, Athuraliya D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their location, boundaries, and extent. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters.
